history.body: Hi, I saw the Pearl Residences ad. Just checking what this project is about.

Hi! Pearl Residences is a residential project. Phase 1 homes are 900 sq. ft. with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. The project uses PPVC, with factory-produced, prefinished modules and quality checks; the project materials state a minimum QLASSIC assurance target of 85%. Are you exploring a home to live in or mainly considering it as an investment?
Mostly just looking for now. I work nearby, so location and the monthly costs would matter to me. I’m not ready to decide anything yet.

That makes sense. Pearl Residences is in established Seberang Jaya, with connectivity toward Sunway Carnival Mall, Chai Leng Park and Butterworth. For recurring costs, the stated maintenance rate is RM0.18 per sq. ft., inclusive of sinking fund; selected clubhouse facilities are pay-per-use, so that rate isn’t a full monthly ownership-cost estimate. When it feels useful, a relaxed viewing could help you judge the location and home for yourself—there’s no need to decide anything now.
